definitions: A sudden, violent attack of an illness, especially epilepsy or a stroke.
A sudden and uncontrollable outburst of emotion or behaviour.
The way in which a garment or component corresponds in size and shape to something else.
A sudden short period of doing something.
examples: She had a fit and collapsed.
He threw a fit when he heard the news.
The dress was a perfect fit.
I only get a fit of gardening once a year.
